realReviews.author: Monika H
realReviews.text: Daniel is a very profesional and skilled carpenter. He gave us a couple of helpfull sugestion during building a deck in our backyard and fixing a fiew things. We were very happy about final results.I definitely recomend his services.

faq.q: Do you build decks and verandahs?
faq.a: Yes. Decks, verandahs and carports are a big part of the work. Send a few photos of the spot for a quote.
Albury, Wodonga, Lavington, Thurgoona, Jindera and the surrounding area. Ask if you're further out.

faq.q: Can you lay new floors and replace trim?
faq.a: Yes. Hardwood and laminate flooring, skirting and architraves. Handy for freshening up a home or rental.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs and repairs?
faq.a: Door adjustments and timber repairs are on the list. Send the details and we'll let you know.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight through, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the job.
